messages.subject: Re: graphs for ROC, Lift don't work
parts:
The prediction function comes from ROCR. Rattle should be checking that you have ROCR installed but seems not to be doing so. You could try

> install.packages("ROCR")
> library(ROCR)

Hopefully that would help!

Regards,
Graham



On 11 November 2012 07:54, B D McCullough <bdmccu...@drexel.edu> wrote:
Ubuntu 10.04, 64 bit AMD
R 2.15.2
Rattle 2.6.21

When I execute Evaluate for Lift or ROC, the graphics window appears but it doesn't show a graph, instead it shows garbage from my screen, e.g., part of a web page that I happen to have open.  In the xterm window I get the following:

Loading required package: caTools
Loading required package: bitops
Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : could not find function "prediction"


Has anyone encountered this?
